label: Clear and simple
summary: Short, punchy sentences and everyday plain-language words
Raised reading ease target (65+) for universal comprehension
No tangled multi-clause syntax or obscure academic vocabulary
writing_style: Short sentences (under 18 words), common vocabulary, and active voice conforming to plain language standards.
messaging_principles: State the single main takeaway first, then provide simple supporting steps.

rules.title: Eliminate Tangled Circumlocutions & Dense Jargon
rules.description: Clear communications replace multi-word bureaucratic padding with direct single words.
rules.do_example: If you have questions, please call or email us today.
rules.dont_example: In the event of the contingency that questions arise at this particular point in time, reach out.

terminology.notes: Prefer direct verbs: 'start' over 'commence operation of'.
